en.title: US Senate Moves to Codify Language Accessibility Standards Amid Trump Opposition
en.summary: The US Senate introduced a bill to codify language accessibility standards, countering efforts by the Trump administration to roll them back. Meanwhile, NDIS reforms in Australia threaten to remove autism support for nearly 145,000 people by 2030. Japan also enacted a new support law for higher brain dysfunction, emphasizing rehabilitation and acceptance.

zh-TW.title: 參議院推語言無障礙標準法案 對抗特朗普
zh-TW.summary: 美國參議院提出法案，將語言無障礙標準編纂為法律，以抵銷特朗普政府試圖廢除的舉措。同時，澳洲殘障保險計畫改革可能導致近14.5萬名自閉症者失去支援。日本亦實施高次腦功能障礙支援法，強調復健與接納。
